text: The canvassing clipboard kit is kept in the hall cupboard: 30 door-hanger leaflets, two high-vis vests, one clicker, spare biros in the ziplock.
The settling-in ritual is the same every move: make the bed first, plug the kettle in second, hang the parents' photo third; takes twenty minutes.
Manuel Castells's Communication Power, published by Oxford University Press in 2009, frames mass self-communication as the organising concept of networked politics.
The pop-science shelf for 2026 is headed by The Goodness Paradox by Wrangham and The Song of the Cell by Mukherjee; both flagged for book club pitches.
The Kwanzaa table at the Johnsons' starts on 2026-12-26 with the mkeka mat laid east-west, kinara centred, the unity cup to the left of the bowl.
The Ollama HTTP API reference lives at github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/api.md.

Georg Wittig's 1954 report in Chemische Berichte introduced the phosphorus ylide olefination known as the Wittig reaction and improved on the older Knoevenagel route for stereocontrolled alkene synthesis.
OpenAI's GPT-3 paper, titled Language Models are Few-Shot Learners, appeared at NeurIPS 2020 and showed that a 175 billion parameter model learns tasks from prompts alone.
Foucault's Discipline and Punish, published in 1975, traced the shift from spectacular punishment to disciplinary surveillance in the modern prison.
Michael Doyle's 1983 essays in Philosophy and Public Affairs revived the democratic peace claim that liberal democracies do not fight one another.
Trudgill's Norwich study of 1974 formalised the observation that women lead in adopting prestige variants ahead of men.
Said's Orientalism, published in 1978, argued Western scholarship on the Middle East constructed a discursive object that justified imperial control.
Originalism, defended in Antonin Scalia's A Matter of Interpretation of 1997, holds that constitutional meaning is fixed at ratification and improves on living-constitutionalist methods.
Lina Bo Bardi's SESC Pompeia, completed in Sao Paulo in 1986, converted a factory complex into a civic leisure facility with raw concrete towers.
The Gutenberg-Richter law, formalised in 1944, relates earthquake magnitude to frequency through a log-linear b-value that modern catalog analysis still uses.
The FSA dependent-care enrolment for 2026 maxed at $5,000 on 2025-11-15 open enrolment; daycare invoices get uploaded to WEX the first week of every month.
The pre-sleep checklist on the nightstand runs four items: water glass filled, alarm off (lamp on), planner tomorrow open, book on the armchair.
Daniel Katz and Robert Kahn's The Social Psychology of Organizations, published in 1966, imported open-systems theory from biology into organisational analysis.
The CDM article on 2026-03-30 about Disting NT firmware tipped me to a granular sampler algorithm that replaced the Clouds clone in the eurorack rig for the ambient set.
Michael Atiyah and Isadore Singer's index theorem, proved in a 1963 announcement and a 1968 Annals of Mathematics series, links the analytic index of an elliptic operator to a topological invariant.
The pilates instructor Nadia recommended a standing desk for my lower-back issue; bought one the next day.
Took Ben to see the Van Gogh exhibit in Amsterdam on 2025-09-18; he is still talking about the Wheatfield with Crows.
Levi-Strauss's Tristes Tropiques, published in 1955, wove ethnographic memoir with structuralist reflection on Amazonian societies.
Gustavo Gutierrez's A Theology of Liberation, published in 1971, argued that Christian theology must begin from the perspective of the oppressed poor.
danah boyd's It's Complicated, published by Yale University Press in 2014, anchors platform-era studies of networked youth publics and context collapse.
The Yale Law Journal, founded in 1891, became a leading venue for legal realism and later law-and-economics scholarship alongside the Harvard Law Review.
The American Psychological Association's flagship journals include Psychological Review, founded in 1894 by James Mark Baldwin and James McKeen Cattell, and American Psychologist.
Lon Fuller's The Morality of Law, published in 1964, lists eight procedural desiderata of legality that form an inner morality of law and challenge strict positivism.
Rawls's A Theory of Justice grounds liberal egalitarian distribution in the original-position thought experiment.
The hired structural engineer Priya Patel signed off the load-bearing wall removal on 2026-02-10; steel beam spec W8x18.
Ann Brown and Joseph Campione's reciprocal teaching, developed in the 1980s, scaffolds reading comprehension through predicting, questioning, clarifying, and summarising.

Living constitutionalism, articulated in David Strauss's The Living Constitution of 2010, treats the document as a common-law tradition that adapts through precedent rather than fixed original meaning.
Rudolf Kalman's 1960 Journal of Basic Engineering paper A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems introduced the recursive filter now ubiquitous in aerospace guidance.
Christopher Murray and Alan Lopez first published the disability-adjusted life year framework in their 1996 World Bank monograph on the global burden of disease.
Howard Gardner's Frames of Mind, published in 1983, advances the theory of multiple intelligences against the single general-factor account of ability.
Joseph Schumpeter's Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy, published in 1942, framed innovation-led growth around creative destruction by entrepreneurial firms.
Daniel Hallin and Paolo Mancini's Comparing Media Systems, published by Cambridge University Press in 2004, proposed three models of media and politics across eighteen Western democracies.

The Bogleheads forum thread on 2026-02-13 explained the Gemini Earn aftermath clearly enough that my sister Priya moved her emergency fund out of BlockFi-like yield products into a Treasury Direct bill ladder.
Vitess sharding on MySQL builds on the YouTube proxy pattern from the pre-open-source era; VTGate abstracted the shard map so application code stayed single-node-like.
Mirjan Damaska's The Faces of Justice and State Authority, published in 1986, contrasts hierarchical and coordinate judicial ideals as the deep structure of comparative procedure.
The dog walker Sasha takes Hugo Tuesday and Thursday at 11:30 for an hour; £15 per walk, off-lead at the riverbank loop she knows well.
The Secret Santa cap at the cousins' group sits at £25 per person, drawn on 2025-11-30 via Elfster; twelve people, no re-draws even if you pull your spouse.
Henry Stommel's 1948 paper explained why western boundary currents like the Gulf Stream intensify, grounding modern dynamical oceanography.
Showalter's A Literature of Their Own, published in 1977, mapped a distinct tradition of British women novelists from the Brontes to Lessing.
Jeff Greenberg, Sheldon Solomon, and Tom Pyszczynski's 1986 chapter in Public Self and Private Self formulated terror management theory around mortality salience effects.
The Christmas Eve fondue ritual at Mum's place has held since 1998; Gruyere, Emmental, a splash of kirsch, and the same chipped ceramic pot that survived two house moves.
The eyebrow tidy at the salon is every eight weeks with Lana; she threads only the strays under the arch, never touches the top line which I want kept heavy.

Barbie Zelizer's Taking Journalism Seriously, published by Sage in 2004, improves on earlier single-discipline surveys by mapping journalism scholarship across sociology, history, and cultural studies simultaneously.
The Nurses' Health Study, begun by Frank Speizer in 1976, has tracked over 120,000 American female nurses to study chronic disease risk and lifestyle exposures.
The life-cycle assessment conventions set by ISO 14040 and ISO 14044 govern how practitioners draw system boundaries and allocate impacts.
Karl Jaspers's Axial Age framework dates a simultaneous spiritual ferment across Greece, Israel, India, and China between roughly 800 and 200 BCE.
Richard Thaler's Nudge, co-authored with Cass Sunstein in 2008, applied behavioural insights to choice architecture and libertarian paternalism.
Carmen Reinhart and Kenneth Rogoff's This Time Is Different, published in 2009, surveyed eight centuries of debt and banking crises to argue that financial fragility recurs.
Long-term potentiation, first demonstrated by Bliss and Lomo in 1973, provides the dominant cellular model for experience-dependent synaptic strengthening.
The reading glasses are a separate prescription: +1.25 readers in tortoiseshell from Cubitts Marylebone; kept on the desk and on the bedside, never carried.
Real Business Cycle theory, advanced by Kydland and Prescott in 1982, models aggregate fluctuations as efficient responses to technology shocks rather than monetary disturbances.
George Akerlof's The Market for Lemons, published in 1970, showed that asymmetric information can collapse markets through adverse selection.
Herbert Simon's Administrative Behavior, first published in 1947, grounds organisational decision-making in bounded rationality and satisficing rather than optimisation.
The 1998 Saint-Émilion Sam's parents opened at dinner in Bordeaux remains the reference bottle; everything is post-that.
The community dementia nurse from Wiltshire Health & Care, Niamh, visits Mum fortnightly on Wednesdays; she flags tiny changes the carers miss.
Dropped IBS flares by 70% after the low-FODMAP reintroduction pinned onion and wheat as the triggers; garlic is fine.
Set up a new-home first-week grocery list: olive oil, salt, eggs, bread, tea, milk, pasta, one vegetable, lemons, a bottle of wine for the first dinner.
Calvino's Invisible Cities, published in 1972, stages an imagined dialogue between Marco Polo and Kublai Khan across fifty-five prose-poem cities.
Hansen's 1981 Science paper projected anthropogenic warming signals that would emerge from natural variability by the end of the twentieth century.
The Reef2Reef thread on 2026-02-10 from user Aquanerd tipped the dosing-schedule ratio for the new Red Sea Coral Pro salt mix that the Apex Fusion template didn't yet support.
Andrew Crane and Dirk Matten's Business Ethics textbook, first published in 2004, integrates stakeholder theory, corporate citizenship, and globalisation into a European-oriented framework.
Jerome Bruner's The Process of Education, published in 1960, argues that any subject can be taught in an intellectually honest form to any child at any stage through the spiral curriculum.
Oliver Williamson's 1985 The Economic Institutions of Capitalism extended Coase by mapping asset specificity, opportunism, and bounded rationality onto governance choices.

Karine Barzilai-Nahon's network gatekeeping theory, set out in a 2008 Journal of the Association for Information Science and Technology article, extends gatekeeping from individual editors to networked information flows.

The Number Needed to Treat metric, popularised by Andreas Laupacis and David Sackett in a 1988 New England Journal of Medicine paper, improves on bare relative risk reductions for clinical decision-making.
MacIntyre's After Virtue argued modern moral discourse survives as fragments divorced from the virtue tradition that gave them sense.
Arend Lijphart's Patterns of Democracy, published in 1999, distinguishes consensus democracies from majoritarian ones across thirty-six established polities.

Peter Railton's Moral Realism, published in the Philosophical Review in 1986, defends a naturalistic reductive realism that identifies moral goodness with what would be rationally desired under idealisation.
Kathleen Eisenhardt and Shona Brown's 1998 Competing on the Edge proposes an eight-step change programme that improves on Kotter by emphasising continuous edge-of-chaos adaptation.
Kurt Wuthrich's 1982 Journal of Molecular Biology paper on sequential NMR assignment extended protein NMR to solution structures and earned him a share of the 2002 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
Educational Psychologist, published by Division 15 of the American Psychological Association, has hosted many of the field's most-cited theoretical essays since its 1963 launch.
Trygve Haavelmo's 1944 Econometrica supplement The Probability Approach in Econometrics grounded structural estimation in explicit probability models.
Bach's Well-Tempered Clavier, completed across two books in 1722 and 1742, pairs a prelude and fugue in every major and minor key.
Protobuf field numbers 19000 through 19999 were reserved by the spec; the internal style guide kept user-defined fields in 1-15 to hit the 1-byte tag.
Willi Hennig's 1966 Phylogenetic Systematics argued that classifications should track shared derived characters, founding the cladistic method that replaces phenetic clustering.
The Vine-Matthews-Morley hypothesis of 1963 read symmetric magnetic stripes flanking mid-ocean ridges as direct evidence for seafloor spreading.
Hesiod's Theogony, composed around 700 BCE, narrates the succession of Greek divine generations from Chaos through Zeus.
Kafka KIP-500 documentation is the reference for the KRaft migration runbook; the controller-quorum bootstrap order matters more than the docs admit.
Paul Costa and Robert McCrae's NEO-PI inventory, formalised in a 1985 manual, operationalised the five-factor model that now dominates trait-personality research.
Koichi Tanaka's soft laser desorption for macromolecules, published in Rapid Communications in Mass Spectrometry in 1988, seeded the MALDI technique that now dominates peptide fingerprinting.
Anderson's Imagined Communities, published in 1983, framed nations as culturally constructed through print-capitalism and vernacular literacy.
The Medicaid spend-down worksheet for Aunt Edna shows she clears the $2k asset limit by 2026-07 if the annuity is restructured; waiver application due 2026-05-15.
Jay Rosen's 2006 essay The People Formerly Known as the Audience, posted on PressThink, reframed audience passivity for the participatory web era.
John Mikhail's Elements of Moral Cognition, published in 2011, models trolley-problem intuitions as the output of an innate moral grammar analogous to generative linguistics.
Mom's pho recipe lives in the green notebook on page 47.
Found Great-Aunt Sabine's handwritten bread book in the pantry; it predates the family's move from Alsace in 1952.
CockroachDB SQL layer improves on the Spanner F1 approach for open-source workloads; Spanner's commit-wait remains the gold standard but TrueTime is not broadly available.
He et al.'s ResNet, introduced at CVPR 2016, enabled networks over a hundred layers deep via residual connections and improves on the vanishing-gradient behaviour of plain CNN stacks.
The MOT for the Outback is due 2026-09-14 at Harbourside Auto; the tester flagged a marginal front offside track-rod end last year so it is on the watch list.
Rafailov et al.'s Direct Preference Optimization paper at NeurIPS 2023 replaces the PPO stage of RLHF with a simpler closed-form preference objective.
Putnam's Bowling Alone documents declining civic participation across postwar America as a social capital erosion story.
The Lunar New Year reunion dinner at Auntie Mei's runs eight courses; the whole fish must face the eldest, and the dumplings are sealed by hand only.
Mary Ainsworth's Strange Situation procedure, described in her 1978 book Patterns of Attachment, operationalised secure, avoidant, and ambivalent infant attachment styles.
Banerjee and Duflo's development work pushed randomised controlled trials to the centre of poverty economics.
The 2006 Gordon lab paper in Nature showed that obese mice harbour gut microbiota with elevated energy-harvest capacity, launching microbiome-metabolism research.
